{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA test orders
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel (unstratified)
overall_conversion = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference = overall_conversion['email'] - overall_conversion['paid_search']

# Convert difference to percentage points
difference_pct_points = difference * 100

# Print results
print("Overall conversion rate by channel:")
print(overall_conversion)
print(f"\nDifference (email - paid_search) in percentage points: {difference_pct_points:.2f}")"}
